## Recent Market Action Monad's recent performance reflects broader volatility in the Layer 1 sector.

Over the past 30 days, the token reached a high of $0.024752 and a low of $0.019808, maintaining a 30-day average of $0.021541. Over the last year, Monad saw a high of $0.047345 and a low of $0.016952, marking a year-to-date change of -30.50%. These figures illustrate the significant range in which the token has oscillated since its inception.

## Key Price Levels

Given the current price of $0.02999112, technical support can be identified near the recent 30-day low of $0.019808. Resistance remains clustered near the all-time high of $0.048829. For the asset to establish a more bullish trend, it [would](/would) need to sustain trading volume above its average levels and clear the psychological barrier of $0.04000.

## Valuation Scenarios In a bear case scenario, continued downward pressure across the sector could test the $0.016366 ATL. A base case assumes the token continues to trade within the recent consolidation range, driven by ecosystem updates and network maturation.

The bull case requires a significant increase in total value locked (TVL) and developer adoption, potentially allowing it to compete more effectively with peers like [Sei](/sei-network) or [Celestia](/celestia), which currently command different market valuations based on their respective modular or parallel architectures.

## Risk Profile TokenRadar assigns Monad a medium risk score of 4.

This is influenced by the 1-year performance dip of -30.50% and the substantial FDV of 2,083,583,522 dollars, which suggests a large supply of tokens yet to enter the market. Volatility remains a factor for participants tracking the asset.

## Sector Comparison

When compared to broader sector performance, Monad occupies a niche in the parallelized EVM category. While [Celestia](/celestia) leads the modular narrative and [Sei](/sei-network) has established a strong footing in parallelized L1s, Monad's success hinges on its ability to execute its technical [vision](/vision-3) flawlessly. In the current market, investors are favoring projects with clear, tangible utility over speculative growth, which places high performance on the successful deployment of the Monad mainnet.
